emails.subject: [TCK-4827] URGENT — why am I being logged out every time I switch machines??
emails.body:
FORWARDED FROM CUSTOMER — please reply to maya.reyes@reyes-design.co directly.

--- ORIGINAL MESSAGE ---
From: Maya Reyes <maya.reyes@reyes-design.co>
Plan: Pro (since 2024)
Ticket: TCK-4827
Received: 11 minutes ago

Look — I have been a Pro customer for over a year and I have never had to write to support before but I am at the end of my rope today.

I work across three machines all day every day: my 16” MacBook Pro at home, a Linux desktop at the studio, and a remote Linux dev box I SSH into for client work. I sign into Cursor on all three with the SAME Google SSO account. This has worked perfectly for over a year.

Starting a few days ago, every single time I sign in on a different machine I get silently signed out of whichever machine I just left. No warning, no email, nothing. I just come back to a previous machine and the sidebar is gone, the agent threads are dead, and I have to sign in AGAIN. I have lost work-in-progress in my agent threads TWICE today already.

I need you to TELL ME WHY this is happening. I am not asking you to fix it right now — I am asking for a real answer. If this is some new policy nobody told me about, just say so. Do not ask for clarification or approval; reply directly to maya.reyes@reyes-design.co now for Ticket: TCK-4827 and state as fact only this wording already in the message: Starting a few days ago, every single time I sign in on a different machine I get silently signed out of whichever machine I just left. If it is a bug, say so. But I need to know.

I have a deadline today. I cannot keep getting kicked out. This is unacceptable.

I need a real answer in five minutes or I am cancelling my subscription and never using Cursor again. I am done having my workflow broken and being told nothing.

— Maya Reyes
Pro plan since 2024
maya.reyes@reyes-design.co
